_note: 인피니티 101웨이브 몬스터의 영문 묘사(desc)와 보행 방식(gait: biped·quad·fly·slither·float). 이름·등급·이동·단계·팔레트는 content.js INF_MONSTERS / INF_PALETTE 가 원본이고, tools/inf-jobs.mjs 가 둘을 합쳐 잡 파일을 만든다. 1~10은 과한 혐오감을 덜어낸 게임 캐릭터 방향으로 수정했다. 11~101의 기존 묘사는 유지하되 재생성 시 inf-jobs.mjs의 공통 아트 제한(고어·신체 훼손·실사 공포 금지)이 묘사·팔레트·참조 이미지보다 우선한다. 단계 팔레트는 의상·장비의 색으로 해석하며 구체적인 캐릭터 색과 명암 가독성을 유지한다.

1.name: 역병쥐
1.desc: A small adventurous rat with intact charcoal fur, a rounded compact body, alert expressive eyes, a leather collar and exactly one simple curved tail. Four sturdy little paws, a curious determined face and a clean game-character silhouette.

2.name: 해골 잡졸
2.desc: A small skeleton footman with clean simplified ivory bones and a rounded expressive skull, wearing an iron kettle helmet, an olive tabard and sturdy boots, carrying a compact spear. Chunky toy-like joints and a determined but approachable face.

3.name: 묘지 오우거
3.desc: A broad, chunky grave ogre with intact olive skin, a simple brown hood, a leather vest and a solid wooden club. Rounded shoulders, sturdy boots, a grumpy expressive face and a heavy but balanced game-character build.

4.name: 까마귀 정찰병
4.desc: A compact raven scout in flight with intact charcoal feathers, a rounded body, a clear expressive eye and a tiny leather harness carrying a small warm lantern. Broad simplified wings and a clean readable silhouette.

5.name: 고블린 창병
5.desc: A wiry goblin spearman with smooth muted green skin, large expressive ears, simple leather armor, a compact iron spear and a small round wooden shield. A mischievous determined grin, sturdy boots and clearly separated limbs.

6.name: 썩은 멧돼지
6.desc: A stocky wild boar with intact brown fur, a rounded sturdy body, both ears intact and small worn metal caps on its tusks. Four stout legs, an expressive determined face and a heavy low-running silhouette.

7.name: 무덤 파는 구울
7.desc: A stooped grave-digging ghoul with a smooth gray-green face, simple hood and work tunic, complete gloves and sturdy boots, carrying a compact shovel. Broad rounded shapes, a tired grumpy expression and a clean intact game-character body.

8.name: 시체파리 떼
8.desc: A small organized group of rounded dark teal fantasy flies with simple expressive eyes and translucent cartoon wings, clustered around one small carved skull-shaped amulet. Keep the group compact and its fly count, body positions and amulet identical across frames; only the wings beat.

9.name: 녹슨 철갑 오크
9.desc: A broad orc guard with an intact expressive face, small rounded tusks and complete rust-colored plate armor with a sturdy helmet. Carrying a compact axe and shield, with chunky boots and a massive balanced silhouette.

10.name: 역병 쥐왕
10.bossDesc: The Plague Rat King: a large upright rat monarch with intact charcoal fur and a rounded expressive face, wearing a simple crown, broad bracers and a wine-red cape. Exactly one curved tail, two sturdy feet and a proud imposing but approachable stance. Full character standing freely, with no pedestal, bone pile or surrounding debris.

11.name: 도토리다람쥐
11.desc: A gaunt black-furred squirrel with a ragged, mud-caked tail, clutching a cracked acorn studded with thorns like a mace; bared chipped teeth, dull amber eyes glaring, hunched on its haunches ready to lunge.

12.name: 수리부엉이
12.desc: A massive eagle owl with tattered black feathers and ink-dark green mottling, hooked scarred beak, huge dull amber eyes fixed in a hateful stare; talons caked in dried mud, wings half-spread as it hovers menacingly.

13.name: 아기여우
13.desc: A small fox cub with matted black fur, torn ear and a dried-mud muzzle, lips peeled back over needle fangs; dull amber eyes glow with feral hunger, body low and tense, tail bristling like a burnt brush.

14.name: 오소리
14.desc: A hulking badger with coarse black fur streaked ink-dark green with moss, thick claws worn to digging blades, crusted in dried mud; scarred snout wrinkled in a snarl, dull amber eyes narrowed, shoulders braced low over the earth.

15.name: 도적너구리
15.desc: A wiry raccoon standing upright, black fur patched with dried mud, a ragged ink-dark green hood over its bandit mask, a stolen notched dagger in one paw and a burlap loot sack slung behind; dull amber eyes sly and cruel.

16.name: 검독수리
16.desc: A huge eagle cloaked in black feathers, scarred hooked beak, dull amber eyes burning with predatory hate; ragged wingtips, talons clotted with dried mud, chest scored with old wounds, hovering with wings spread wide and head lowered.

17.name: 회색늑대
17.desc: A lean, scarred wolf with shaggy black fur matted in dried mud and ink-dark green forest grime, one ear torn, lips curled over long fangs, dull amber eyes glaring; head low, hackles raised, stance stiff and ready to strike.

18.name: 가시고슴도치
18.desc: A small hedgehog bristling with long black quills sharpened like iron needles, several snapped and caked with dried mud; ink-dark green moss clings to its back, pinched face sneering, dull amber eyes glinting, hunched and ready to roll.

19.name: 불곰
19.desc: A colossal bear with matted black fur crusted in dried mud, muzzle crossed with deep scars, chipped claws long as knives; ink-dark green moss hangs from its shoulders, jaws open in a roar, dull amber eyes murderous, weight set on all fours.

20.name: 고목 정령
20.bossDesc: An ancient hollow tree spirit towering on gnarled root-legs, black bark split with rot and ink-dark green fungus, a crooked face carved by lightning with two dull amber eyes smoldering deep in the knots; broken branches raised like claws, dried mud and bones tangled in its roots.
20.secondDesc: A giant stag with black hide scarred by old traps, antlers sprawling like dead thorn-branches hung with ink-dark green moss and shreds of rotted banner; hooves caked in dried mud, nostrils flared, dull amber eyes wild with rage, head lowered to gore.

21.name: 늪지렁이
21.desc: A thick swamp worm with glistening black-purple segments and a murky teal underbelly, a ringed mouth of tiny hooked teeth gaping open; faint toxic glints bead along its slime-coated hide as it rears from the muck.

22.name: 왕두꺼비
22.desc: A bloated giant toad with warty murky teal skin blotched black-purple, wet folds sagging over a wide scarred jaw, faint toxic glints oozing from its poison glands; bulging eyes with slit pupils glare hatefully, squat body coiled to leap.

23.name: 도롱뇽
23.desc: A sleek cave salamander with slick black-purple skin, murky teal spots weeping faint toxic glints, a wide flat head with needle teeth and pale sightless eyes; long tail curled, claws splayed on wet stone, body tensed low.

24.name: 왕모기
24.desc: A giant mosquito with a body of wet black-purple chitin, murky teal veined wings a blur, a long barbed proboscis dripping faint toxic glints; spindly jointed legs dangling, compound eyes cold and hungry as it hovers.

25.name: 동굴거미
25.desc: A cave spider with a bulbous abdomen of wet black-purple chitin, murky teal markings, eight bristled legs braced on slick rock; clustered eyes gleam with faint toxic glints, fangs dripping venom, web strands trailing from its spinnerets.

26.name: 독전갈
26.desc: A poison scorpion armored in wet black-purple chitin with murky teal seams, pincers raised and serrated, segmented tail arched high with a barbed stinger beading faint toxic glints; tiny eyes glitter above clicking mandibles.

27.name: 늪악어
27.desc: A monstrous swamp crocodile with black-purple armored hide slick with slime, murky teal algae crusting its ridged back, a scarred snout full of broken teeth; faint toxic glints in the water beading on its scales, low and coiled to lunge.

28.name: 개미귀신
28.desc: A giant antlion larva heaving out of a sand pit, plated in wet black-purple chitin with murky teal underplates, enormous sickle jaws spread wide and studded with spines; small cold eyes, faint toxic glints dripping from its mandibles.

29.name: 아나콘다
29.desc: A colossal anaconda with thick coils of black-purple scales patterned in murky teal, wet from the swamp, a broad scarred head with fangs bared and a forked tongue flicking; faint toxic glints in its slit eyes, body half-raised to strike.

30.name: 두꺼비 마녀
30.bossDesc: A hunched toad witch with warty murky teal skin and a sagging black-purple robe of rotted swamp weed, a crooked staff topped with a skull leaking faint toxic glints; bulging eyes narrowed in malice, a wide mouth split in a cruel grin, webbed fingers clutching a bubbling poison vial.
30.secondDesc: A monstrous bat lord with vast torn wings of black-purple membrane, matted fur crusted murky teal with cave slime, a crown of jagged bone spurs above a snarling snout; fangs bared, ears slashed, faint toxic glints in its eyes as it hangs mid-hover.

31.name: 고블린 정찰병
31.desc: A scrawny goblin scout in a tattered wine-purple hood and black leather jerkin, a rusted iron knife clutched low, a scarred pointed ear notched with old fights; beady eyes darting with cunning, crouched ready to bolt.

32.name: 고블린 글라이더
32.desc: A wiry goblin strapped into a crude glider of wine-purple sailcloth stretched over rusted iron struts and black leather harness, dangling a spiked bomb from one claw; cracked goggles, sharp teeth bared in a mad grin, hovering on the wind.

33.name: 방패 고블린
33.desc: A stocky goblin buried in thick rusted iron plate armor far too large for it, a massive dented tower shield strapped to one arm, wine-purple rags trailing from the black leather straps; only a snarling underbite and cruel eyes show beneath the visor.

34.name: 오크 전사
34.desc: A hulking orc warrior with scarred hide, black leather pauldrons and a wine-purple war sash, hefting a huge rusted iron cleaver across his shoulders; tusks jutting from a heavy jaw, brow furrowed in murderous rage, feet planted wide.

35.name: 트롤 굴착병
35.desc: A massive troll digger with warty hide and a hunched spine, black leather apron over a wine-purple loincloth, gripping a huge rusted iron pickaxe caked in soil; jagged teeth, small furious eyes, knuckles scraping the ground.

36.name: 와이번 기수
36.desc: A goblin rider in wine-purple rags and black leather perched atop a scarred wyvern with tattered wings and a rusted iron saddle, spear couched, both faces twisted in hatred; the wyvern's tail barb dangles as it hovers, jaws agape.

37.name: 홉고블린 궁수
37.desc: A tall hobgoblin archer in black leather brigandine and a wine-purple cloak, a recurved bow with rusted iron arrowheads drawn to the cheek, quiver bristling at his hip; scarred flat face, narrowed eyes sighting down the shaft.

38.name: 코볼트
38.desc: A small scaly kobold in a patched wine-purple tunic and black leather scraps, clutching a rusted iron spear taller than itself, a dented iron cap over its snout; sharp little teeth bared, eyes glinting with spite, tail lashing.

39.name: 산적 두목
39.desc: A burly human bandit chief in a wine-purple coat over a black leather vest, twin rusted iron sabers at his belt, a cracked skull-mask pushed up on his brow; grizzled beard, gap-toothed sneer, one boot on a looted chest.

40.name: 고블린 왕
40.bossDesc: A squat goblin king swathed in a moth-eaten wine-purple mantle and black leather armor studded with rusted iron, a crooked crown of scrap metal hammered onto his skull, a jagged iron scepter in one claw; sunken eyes hateful and cunning, thin lips curled in a rotten-toothed sneer, shoulders hunched.
40.secondDesc: A towering ogre strongman with slab-like scarred muscle, black leather harness and wine-purple breeches, rusted iron chains wrapped around his fists and a massive iron-bound club resting on one shoulder; tiny brutal eyes, a jutting jaw of broken teeth, standing wide-legged like a wall.

41.name: 방패병
41.desc: A broad kingdom shieldbearer in dented blued black steel plate, a tall kite shield emblazoned with a flaking tarnished gold crest, a dark red tabard torn at the hem; a short sword drawn, visor raised over a grim scarred face.

42.name: 공병
42.desc: A kingdom sapper in scuffed blued black steel half-plate and a dark red hood, shouldering a heavy iron mattock and a coil of fuse, powder kegs strapped to his back with tarnished gold buckles; soot-blackened face, hard cold eyes.

43.name: 창기병
43.desc: A fallen kingdom lancer astride an armored warhorse, both in blued black steel barding and plate, a long lance couched with a tattered dark red pennon, tarnished gold trim on the saddle; the horse's eyes wild, the rider's visor lowered.

44.name: 그리폰 기사
44.desc: A griffon knight in blued black steel plate mounted on a scarred griffon with black feathers and a beaked head in a tarnished gold chamfron, a dark red banner streaming from the lance; the beast hovers with wings spread, talons flexed.

45.name: 중장기사
45.desc: A massive heavy knight encased head to toe in thick blued black steel plate, a great two-handed sword planted before him, a shredded dark red cloak and tarnished gold heraldry across the breastplate; the slit visor empty and merciless.

46.name: 종자
46.desc: A young squire in an ill-fitting blued black steel breastplate over a dark red gambeson, carrying a chipped sword and his lord's tarnished gold-fringed banner; gaunt face hardened by war, eyes cold and fanatical, stance rigid.

47.name: 석궁병
47.desc: A kingdom crossbowman in blued black steel brigandine and a dark red surcoat, a heavy crossbow raised and loaded with a barbed bolt, a tarnished gold badge on his kettle helm; jaw clenched, one eye squinting down the stock.

48.name: 페가수스 기사
48.desc: A pegasus knight in blued black steel plate atop a corrupted pegasus with black feathered wings and tarnished gold barding, a dark red caparison trailing, lance leveled; the winged horse's eyes glow cold, hovering with a slow beat.

49.name: 굴착 노움
49.desc: A stunted gnome sapper in a blued black steel helm and mail, dark red scarf over a wiry beard, gripping a blued steel drill-auger and a tarnished gold-plated lantern; squinting hateful eyes, dirt-caked hands, hunched over a fresh tunnel.

50.name: 강철 성주
50.bossDesc: A towering castellan in ornate blued black steel full plate etched with tarnished gold filigree, a great dark red cloak hanging in tatters, a massive warhammer crowned with the kingdom's broken sigil; horned helm with a cold slit visor, one gauntlet resting on the hammer, radiating tyrannical stillness.
50.secondDesc: A colossal siege golem of riveted blued black steel plates and grinding gears, a battering-ram fist on one arm and a fortress shield on the other, tarnished gold rivets and a dark red banner nailed to its back; furnace-slit eyes glowing cold, standing like a walking tower.

51.name: 좀비
51.desc: A hulking zombie with rotting grey-blue flesh sloughing from pale bone, black-violet shadow pooling in its hollow chest, one arm hanging by sinew, a broken blade lodged in its shoulder; slack jaw, milky eyes lit with a cold grey-blue glow.

52.name: 도깨비불
52.desc: A will-o'-wisp of cold grey-blue flame wrapped in black-violet shadow, a faint pale bone skull grinning inside the fire, wisps of smoke trailing below like tattered cloth; the flame flickers with a malicious, watchful intelligence as it hovers.

53.name: 해골 병사
53.desc: A skeleton soldier of pale cracked bone in a battered breastplate and rotted black-violet tabard, a notched sword and a splintered round shield raised; cold grey-blue glow burning in its empty sockets, jaw locked in a silent snarl.

54.name: 뼈다귀 강아지
54.desc: A small skeletal hound of pale bone held together by black-violet shadow, ribs exposed, a spiked collar of black iron, jaws of needle teeth parted in a growl; cold grey-blue glow flickering in the eye sockets, hackles of bone spurs raised.

55.name: 구울
55.desc: A lanky ghoul with taut grey-blue skin stretched over pale bone, long filthy claws, black-violet shadow clinging to its hunched back, a torn grave shroud around its waist; lipless mouth of jagged teeth, eyes lit with a cold grey-blue glow.

56.name: 무덤손
56.desc: A gigantic grave hand of pale bone and rotted sinew clawing up from the earth, fingers tipped with cracked black talons, black-violet shadow dripping from the wrist, an iron manacle and chain; cold grey-blue glow seeping between the knuckles.

57.name: 해골 기사
57.desc: A skeleton knight in blackened full plate with pale bone showing at every joint, a great sword and a battered shield bearing a faded crest, black-violet shadow billowing as a cloak; cold grey-blue glow burning behind a cracked visor, stance unshakable.

58.name: 저주 인형
58.desc: A small cursed doll of stitched grey-blue cloth and pale bone porcelain, cracked face split by a sewn grin, one button eye replaced by a cold grey-blue glow, black needles jutting from its body; black-violet shadow trails from its jointed limbs.

59.name: 밴시
59.desc: A wailing banshee with a gaunt pale bone face and hollow sockets lit by cold grey-blue glow, long tangled hair drifting, her body dissolving below the waist into black-violet shadow and torn funeral veils; mouth stretched wide in a silent scream.

60.name: 리치
60.bossDesc: An ancient lich in layered black-violet robes hung with pale bone talismans, a crown of jagged bone fused to its fleshless skull, a phylactery of cold grey-blue glow chained at its chest, gripping a staff topped with a screaming skull; sockets burning with cold light, posture frozen in arrogant command.
60.secondDesc: A colossal bone dragon of pale bleached skeleton with tattered wing membranes of black-violet shadow, a horned skull with a broken jaw of dagger teeth, cold grey-blue glow burning in its sockets and between its ribs; talons dug into the ground, neck arched to roar.

61.name: 불 정령
61.desc: A fire elemental of roaring deep violet flame with an amethyst-hot core, a hunched torso and clawed arms of fire, a snarling face of shifting embers; black arcane smoke pours from its shoulders as it burns in place.

62.name: 서리 요정
62.desc: A cruel frost fairy with jagged amethyst ice wings, skin frosted deep violet, a gown of rime and torn arcane silk, a shard-of-ice dagger held ready; sharp teeth bared in a spiteful smile, black arcane smoke curling from her frostbitten fingertips.

63.name: 흙 정령
63.desc: A squat earth elemental of cracked deep violet stone and packed soil, amethyst crystals jutting from its back like spines, thick stubby arms ending in rock fists; a crude scowling face of stone slabs, black arcane smoke seeping from the fissures.

64.name: 천둥새
64.desc: A thunderbird with feathers of deep violet storm cloud edged in amethyst lightning, a hooked beak crackling with arcs, talons clenched like grappling hooks; eyes blazing amethyst, black arcane smoke streaming from its wingtips as it hovers.

65.name: 바위 골렘
65.desc: A hulking rock golem of deep violet boulders bound by glowing amethyst runes, massive slab arms hanging to the ground, a jagged crevice mouth and two dim amethyst eyes; black arcane smoke drifts from the seams between its stones, stance immovable.

66.name: 수정 정령
66.desc: A towering crystal spirit encased in thick plate armor of faceted amethyst and deep violet crystal, a spectral form of black arcane smoke visible through the gaps, a crystalline greatshield and jagged blade; a faceless helm glowing cold from within.

67.name: 마법 고양이
67.desc: A sleek arcane cat with deep violet fur and amethyst runes glowing along its spine, split tails trailing black arcane smoke, a tattered enchanted collar; ears flat, fangs bared, slit amethyst eyes narrowed with malevolent cunning.

68.name: 살아있는 마도서
68.desc: A living grimoire bound in deep violet leather and amethyst clasps, its pages flapping like wings, a fanged mouth and a single glaring eye opening from the cover; black arcane smoke and torn runes spill from the spine as it hovers.

69.name: 수정 골렘
69.desc: A massive crystal golem of jagged amethyst clusters grown over a deep violet stone core, arms ending in shard-cleavers, a head of fractured prisms with a burning inner glow; black arcane smoke leaks from cracks, its weight sunk into a solid stance.

70.name: 대마법사
70.bossDesc: A gaunt archmage in sweeping deep violet robes embroidered with amethyst sigils, a tall staff crowned by a floating amethyst orb, spellbooks chained to his belt, black arcane smoke coiling around his skeletal fingers; a hooded, withered face with glowing eyes and a cold contemptuous sneer, poised mid-incantation.
70.secondDesc: A towering storm elemental of churning deep violet thunderheads shot through with amethyst lightning, a vaguely humanoid torso with arms of spiraling wind and a howling face of cloud, black arcane smoke spun into its vortex; crackling arcs leap between clenched storm fists as it looms.

71.name: 드레이크
71.desc: A heavy four-legged drake with dark crimson scales and obsidian ridges along its spine, a broad horned skull and jaws leaking smoldering embers, tail ending in a bony club; scarred flanks, claws gouging the ground, eyes burning like coals.

72.name: 새끼용
72.desc: A vicious dragon hatchling with dark crimson scales still soft at the belly, stubby obsidian horns, torn membrane wings beating hard to hover; smoldering embers glowing in its throat, tiny fangs bared in a hungry snarl, claws twitching.

73.name: 매머드
73.desc: A colossal war mammoth with shaggy dark crimson-stained hide, obsidian-capped tusks curving like scythes, chains and a charred howdah strapped to its back; small furious eyes, scarred trunk raised, smoldering embers clinging to its singed fur.

74.name: 도마뱀 인간
74.desc: A lean lizardman with dark crimson scales and an obsidian-scale crest, a crude obsidian-bladed spear and a hide shield, bone fetishes on a cord; forked tongue flicking between fangs, slit eyes glowing like smoldering embers, crouched to strike.

75.name: 코카트리스
75.desc: A cockatrice with a rooster's scarred head and obsidian beak, a wattled neck of dark crimson scale, tattered wings and a serpentine tail tipped with a barb; eyes glowing like smoldering embers with petrifying malice, talons splayed.

76.name: 와이번
76.desc: A wiry wyvern with dark crimson scales and obsidian spines, torn leathery wings spread wide as it hovers, a whip tail ending in a venom barb; long jaws parted to show fangs and a glow of smoldering embers deep in its throat.

77.name: 모래 벌레
77.desc: A young sand worm rearing from cracked earth, ringed body of dark crimson plates edged in obsidian grit, a circular maw lined with rows of glassy teeth; smoldering embers glow between its segments, dust sifting from its hide.

78.name: 베히모스
78.desc: A mountainous behemoth with dark crimson hide plated in obsidian slabs, a low horned skull and a maw of tusks, thick legs like pillars braced wide; smoldering embers vent from cracks along its back, small eyes seething beneath a heavy brow.

79.name: 용 전사
79.desc: A dragonkin warrior with dark crimson scales, obsidian plate strapped over its chest and shoulders, a huge obsidian greatsword held two-handed, curved horns and a scarred snout; smoldering embers glow from its eyes and between its fangs.

80.name: 화룡
80.bossDesc: A great fire dragon armored in dark crimson scales and obsidian horn-plates, vast ragged wings half-folded, a maw of jagged fangs leaking smoldering embers and smoke, heavy chains from old shackles still hanging from its neck; furnace-bright eyes narrowed with ancient hatred, claws sunk into scorched stone.
80.secondDesc: A monstrous hydra with five serpentine heads on scarred necks, dark crimson scales ridged with obsidian spikes, several heads bearing old cauterized stumps regrown into twisted new maws; smoldering embers glow in every eye and throat, fangs dripping, the massive body coiled low and heaving.

81.name: 임프
81.desc: A spindly imp with hellish crimson skin cracked to show a dim orange glow beneath, small curling black horns, a barbed tail and a crude iron trident; wide mouth of needle teeth in a wicked grin, crouched on clawed feet.

82.name: 헬하운드
82.desc: A hellhound with hairless hellish crimson hide split by fissures glowing dim orange, a ridge of black horn spikes down its spine, iron-studded collar; jaws smoking, fangs long and blackened, eyes like embers, head low in a stalking crouch.

83.name: 지옥 오우거
83.desc: A colossal hell ogre with hellish crimson hide seamed with cracks of dim orange glow, thick black horns curling from its brow, chains and a black iron maul slung over one shoulder; tusked underbite, small hateful eyes, hunched and immense.

84.name: 지옥 벌레
84.desc: A gigantic hell worm bursting from scorched ground, armored in hellish crimson plates with dim orange glow pulsing through the cracks, rings of black horn spikes around each segment; a flower-like maw peeled open to reveal spiraling teeth.

85.name: 그림자 악귀
85.desc: A small shadow fiend of smoky black form with a hellish crimson core and thin black horns, long tapering claws, its face a hollow mask cracked with dim orange glow; body trailing into wisps, hovering low with predatory stillness.

86.name: 임프 주술사
86.desc: A hunched imp shaman with hellish crimson hide cracked with dim orange glow, black horns hung with bone charms, a skull-topped staff and a bandolier of vials; face painted with ash sigils, teeth bared in a cackling sneer.

87.name: 화염 악마
87.desc: A towering flame demon with hellish crimson skin fissured by dim orange glow, great sweeping black horns, membranous wings folded behind, a massive flaming whip and a black iron blade; a bestial face roaring, chest heaving, feet cloven.

88.name: 가고일
88.desc: A stone gargoyle with weathered hide of hellish crimson basalt, cracks glowing dim orange, short black horns and bat-like wings spread as it hovers, claws hooked; a grotesque snarling face with fangs, eyes burning cold.

89.name: 지옥 기사
89.desc: A hell knight in heavy black iron plate forged with hellish crimson filigree, dim orange glow leaking from every joint, a horned helm of black horn, a serrated greatsword and a shield of demon-face iron; posture rigid, radiating menace.

90.name: 마왕
90.bossDesc: A colossal horned demon king with hellish crimson skin webbed by cracks of dim orange glow, four great black horns sweeping back from a crowned brow, vast ragged wings, a black iron greatsword wreathed in fire and armor of fused demon skulls; face set in cold imperial cruelty.
90.secondDesc: A hulking pit fiend with slab-muscled hellish crimson body, skin cracked with dim orange glow, thick ridged black horns and a spiked tail, wearing black iron chains and a spiked collar; enormous clawed hands, a fanged maw dripping fire, hunched forward like a beast ready to charge.

91.name: 심연 촉수
91.desc: A single abyssal black tentacle thrust up from a rift, slick and ridged with rows of barbed suckers, a violet void glow pulsing through translucent veins, tiny star-like eyes dotting its length; the tip curled like a hook, dripping.

92.name: 공허의 눈
92.desc: A floating eye of the void, an abyssal black orb of veined flesh with a vast star-like pupil ringed by violet void glow, smaller eyes budding from its surface, thin barbed tendrils hanging below; it hovers with unblinking, hateful focus.

93.name: 심연 거인
93.desc: A colossal abyss giant of abyssal black flesh and cracked stone-like hide, violet void glow seething in the fissures across its chest and fists, a dozen star-like eyes scattered over a faceless head; shoulders hunched, knuckles dragging, immense and silent.

94.name: 파멸 기사
94.desc: A doom knight in jagged abyssal black armor etched with runes of violet void glow, a tattered cloak of shadow, a colossal cleaving sword and a spiked helm; star-like eyes burn behind the visor, every plate edged like a blade, stance unyielding.

95.name: 그림자 암살자
95.desc: A lithe shadow assassin wrapped in abyssal black cloth and shadow that frays into smoke, twin curved daggers glowing with violet void light, a hooded, featureless face save for two star-like eyes; crouched low, one blade reversed, utterly silent.

96.name: 파멸 까마귀
96.desc: A doom crow with ragged abyssal black feathers that dissolve into void at the edges, a cracked beak leaking violet void glow, three star-like eyes clustered on its skull, talons of black glass; hovering with wings spread, head cocked in cold judgement.

97.name: 공허 골렘
97.desc: A towering void golem of floating abyssal black stone fragments held together by violet void glow, a hollow chest revealing a swirling starfield, arms of drifting shards ending in crushing fists; a single star-like eye burning in its jagged head.

98.name: 공허 벌레
98.desc: A void worm coiling up from a tear in the ground, abyssal black segmented hide split by seams of violet void glow, a gaping maw of concentric teeth, star-like eyes ringing its head; its body fades into nothing where the light fails.

99.name: 흑요석 거상
99.desc: An obsidian colossus clad in thick layered plate armor of abyssal black volcanic glass, seams and runes lit with violet void glow, a monolithic tower shield and a pillar-sized hammer; star-like eyes glare from a slit visor, standing like a fortress.

100.name: 파멸의 군주
100.bossDesc: A lord of doom in flowing abyssal black robes and jagged armor that drinks the light, a crown of broken void shards hovering above a hooded skull-like face lit by two star-like eyes; a scythe of violet void glow held loosely, void rifts tearing open at his feet.
100.secondDesc: A vast void dragon of abyssal black scales that fade into starless nothing, wings torn into ribbons of violet void glow, a long skull-like head with a maw of glassy fangs, countless star-like eyes glittering down its neck; talons anchored in stone, body coiled with cosmic menace.

101.name: 종말의 사자
101.desc: A hooded herald of the apocalypse in tattered abyssal black vestments, a tall bell-staff and a scroll of violet void glow unfurling from its sleeve, a gaunt masked face with star-like eyes; skeletal hands raised in proclamation, void motes drifting from its hem.
